Class Simulation

java.lang.Object
traffic.sim.Simulation
public class Simulation extends Object
Fixed-step simulation engine. All rules live here so that the domain objects (Car, Lane, ...) stay small and explainable. Model: continuous road units. Cars carry visible body dimensions, and collisions are checked against those same body intervals.
